tables.name: subject_graph
tables.description: One native SubjectGraph; graph-local IDs are preserved verbatim.

tables.name: entity
tables.description: An entity identity within one graph, with descriptive scalar attributes.

tables.name: entity_alias
tables.description: Aliases are rows, not relationship arrays.

tables.name: occurrence
tables.description: Independent occurrence; start/end reference temporal values, not renderer coordinates.

tables.name: occurrence_participant
tables.description: Membership only: permits actions/transactions to reference actual participants without selecting a role record.

tables.name: participation
tables.description: Role and temporal details of an occurrence participant; multiple role records remain valid.

tables.name: action
tables.description: Native actor_id and occurrence_id refer to occurrence membership; no role-interval inference.

tables.name: financial_transaction
tables.description: Transaction occurrence and optional known entity parties; unknown parties are NULL.

tables.name: transaction_instrument
tables.description: Ordered native instrument descriptions; no invented global instrument identity.

tables.name: entity_relation
tables.description: Time-qualified entity relationship independent of joint participation in any occurrence.

tables.name: relation_occurrence
tables.description: Contextual M:N relation/occurrence association, without a co-participation requirement.

tables.name: source_document
tables.description: Exact source text when available; no source is fabricated for unresolved quotations.

tables.name: evidence_span
tables.description: Verbatim quote; document and half-open Unicode offsets are jointly known or jointly unknown.
constraints: CONSTRAINT `ck_span_location` CHECK ((`document_id` IS NULL AND `char_start` IS NULL AND `char_end` IS NULL) OR (`document_id` IS NOT NULL AND `char_start` IS NOT NULL AND `char_end` IS NOT NULL AND `char_end` > `char_start`))

tables.name: evidence_set
tables.description: Metadata contains reasons, confidence and evidence_status by local field path; no copied values or quotes.

tables.name: evidence_link
tables.description: M:N field-to-quote references; actual FKs anchor every evidence container and span.

tables.name: time_value
tables.description: Native value plus an optional explicitly supplied time_window; no inferred date bounds are cached.
constraints: CONSTRAINT `ck_time_window` CHECK ((`window_start` IS NULL AND `window_end` IS NULL AND `original_text` IS NULL AND `is_approximate` IS NULL) OR (`window_start` IS NOT NULL AND `window_end` IS NOT NULL AND `original_text` IS NOT NULL AND `is_approximate` IS NOT NULL AND `window_start` <= `window_end` AND `is_approximate` IN (0,1)))
CONSTRAINT ck_window_semantics CHECK (window_semantics IS NULL OR (window_start IS NOT NULL AND window_semantics IN ('uncertainty','duration')))

tables.name: occurrence_label
tables.description: Optional graph-wide shorter label for an existing occurrence; original title is preserved.

tables.name: activity
tables.description: One activity handle per existing action, transaction or contextual occurrence. No copied fact values.
constraints: CONSTRAINT ck_activity_one_fact CHECK ((CASE WHEN action_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN transaction_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END + CASE WHEN context_occurrence_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) = 1)

tables.name: activity_detail
tables.description: Canonical ordered details. Native action detail indices and evidence remain unchanged.

tables.name: domain
tables.description: Task-specific domain label for one person graph.

tables.name: event
tables.description: An ongoing matter organized around the focal person; one primary domain.

tables.name: stage
tables.description: Evidence-supported period of the person's involvement. stage_id is local to its event.

tables.name: event_activity
tables.description: M:N placement; nullable stage permits unsegmented events. It never changes the actor.

tables.name: event_activity_detail
tables.description: Optional selection of existing detail rows for one placement, with FKs to both sides.

tables.name: activity_relation
tables.description: Graph-wide semantic edge between canonical activities; evidence for the edge is separate from endpoint evidence.
constraints: CONSTRAINT ck_semantic_link_evidence CHECK (relation_type IN ('precedes','overlaps') OR evidence_set_id IS NOT NULL)
CONSTRAINT uq_activity_link UNIQUE (graph_id, from_activity_id, to_activity_id, relation_type)
CONSTRAINT ck_temporal_basis CHECK (basis <> 'temporal' OR relation_type IN ('precedes','overlaps'))

views.name: v_activity_facts
views.description: Dereference the canonical fact and retain original actors, parties and occurrence context.
views.sql:
SELECT a.graph_id, a.activity_id, 'action' AS fact_type, x.action_id AS fact_id,
 x.occurrence_id, x.actor_id, NULL AS from_entity_id, NULL AS to_entity_id,
 x.action_type AS title, x.timestamp_time_id AS start_time_id, x.timestamp_time_id AS end_time_id, x.evidence_set_id
FROM activity a JOIN action x ON x.graph_id=a.graph_id AND x.action_id=a.action_id
UNION ALL
SELECT a.graph_id,a.activity_id,'transaction',t.transaction_id,t.occurrence_id,NULL,t.from_entity_id,t.to_entity_id,
 t.name,t.timestamp_time_id,t.timestamp_time_id,t.evidence_set_id
FROM activity a JOIN financial_transaction t ON t.graph_id=a.graph_id AND t.transaction_id=a.transaction_id
UNION ALL
SELECT a.graph_id,a.activity_id,'context',e.occurrence_id,e.occurrence_id,NULL,NULL,NULL,e.title,e.start_time_id,e.end_time_id,e.evidence_set_id
FROM activity a JOIN occurrence e ON e.graph_id=a.graph_id AND e.occurrence_id=a.context_occurrence_id

views.name: v_person_timeline
views.description: One row per event/activity placement, with typed hierarchy; no organization decisions in the renderer.
views.sql:
SELECT g.graph_id,g.subject_entity_id,p.name AS person_name,
 d.domain_id,d.label AS domain_label,d.sort_order AS domain_order,
 s.event_id,s.label AS event_label,s.summary AS event_summary,s.sort_order AS event_order,
 st.stage_id,st.label AS stage_label,st.summary AS stage_summary,st.boundary_reason,st.sort_order AS stage_order,
 sa.activity_id,sa.sort_order AS activity_order,sa.detail_mode,COALESCE(sa.display_title,f.title) AS display_title,
 f.fact_type,f.fact_id,f.occurrence_id,f.actor_id,f.from_entity_id,f.to_entity_id,
 e.title AS occurrence_title,COALESCE(el.label,e.title) AS occurrence_display_label,e.descriptions AS occurrence_descriptions,e.subject_relevance,
 f.start_time_id,f.end_time_id,ts.value AS start_value,te.value AS end_value,
 ts.window_start AS start_window_start,ts.window_end AS start_window_end,
 ts.original_text AS start_original_text,ts.is_approximate AS start_is_approximate,ts.window_semantics AS start_window_semantics,
 te.window_start AS end_window_start,te.window_end AS end_window_end,
 te.original_text AS end_original_text,te.is_approximate AS end_is_approximate,te.window_semantics AS end_window_semantics,f.evidence_set_id,
 CASE WHEN f.actor_id=g.subject_entity_id THEN 'personal' WHEN f.fact_type='action' THEN 'other_actor' WHEN f.fact_type='transaction' THEN 'transaction' ELSE 'context' END AS activity_role
FROM event_activity sa
JOIN event s ON s.graph_id=sa.graph_id AND s.event_id=sa.event_id
JOIN domain d ON d.graph_id=s.graph_id AND d.domain_id=s.domain_id
JOIN subject_graph g ON g.graph_id=sa.graph_id
JOIN entity p ON p.graph_id=g.graph_id AND p.entity_id=g.subject_entity_id
LEFT JOIN stage st ON st.graph_id=sa.graph_id AND st.event_id=sa.event_id AND st.stage_id=sa.stage_id
JOIN v_activity_facts f ON f.graph_id=sa.graph_id AND f.activity_id=sa.activity_id
JOIN occurrence e ON e.graph_id=f.graph_id AND e.occurrence_id=f.occurrence_id
LEFT JOIN occurrence_label el ON el.graph_id=e.graph_id AND el.occurrence_id=e.occurrence_id
LEFT JOIN time_value ts ON ts.graph_id=f.graph_id AND ts.time_id=f.start_time_id
LEFT JOIN time_value te ON te.graph_id=f.graph_id AND te.time_id=f.end_time_id

views.name: v_activity_hover_details
views.description: All or explicitly selected details for each placement.
views.sql:
SELECT sa.graph_id,sa.event_id,sa.activity_id,d.detail_index,d.value,d.evidence_set_id
FROM event_activity sa JOIN activity_detail d ON d.graph_id=sa.graph_id AND d.activity_id=sa.activity_id
WHERE sa.detail_mode='all' OR EXISTS
 (SELECT 1 FROM event_activity_detail sd WHERE sd.graph_id=sa.graph_id AND sd.event_id=sa.event_id AND sd.activity_id=sa.activity_id AND sd.detail_index=d.detail_index)

views.name: v_event_links
views.description: Edges whose two endpoints belong to the same event. Cross-event edges remain in activity_relation.
views.sql:
SELECT l.graph_id,a.event_id,l.link_id,l.from_activity_id,l.to_activity_id,l.relation_type,l.description,l.basis,l.evidence_set_id
FROM activity_relation l
JOIN event_activity a ON a.graph_id=l.graph_id AND a.activity_id=l.from_activity_id
JOIN event_activity b ON b.graph_id=l.graph_id AND b.activity_id=l.to_activity_id AND b.event_id=a.event_id

views.name: v_event_entity_relations
views.description: Distinct occurrence-context entity relations; there is no joint-participation requirement.
views.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT sa.graph_id,sa.event_id,r.relation_id,r.from_entity_id,r.to_entity_id,r.relation_type,r.valid_from_time_id,r.valid_to_time_id,r.evidence_set_id
FROM event_activity sa
JOIN v_activity_facts f ON f.graph_id=sa.graph_id AND f.activity_id=sa.activity_id
JOIN relation_occurrence re ON re.graph_id=f.graph_id AND re.occurrence_id=f.occurrence_id
JOIN entity_relation r ON r.graph_id=re.graph_id AND r.relation_id=re.relation_id

views.name: v_evidence
views.description: Field-specific evidence and known source locations.
views.sql:
SELECT l.graph_id,l.evidence_set_id,l.field_path,l.quote_order,s.span_id,s.quote,s.document_id,s.char_start,s.char_end,d.source_url,d.title AS source_title,d.published_at
FROM evidence_link l JOIN evidence_span s ON s.graph_id=l.graph_id AND s.span_id=l.span_id
LEFT JOIN source_document d ON d.graph_id=s.graph_id AND d.document_id=s.document_id
